profit_quality.assessment: 主业 2024 年转为亏损，且利润质量受大额应收、信用减值和存货/商誉减值拖累。证券公允价值损失有一次性成分，但信用减值和营运资金占用不能简单加回。本次用 RMB40 million 作为折前可分配现金利润的保守经营能力数，再按 0.30 折成 RMB12 million。
adjustments: 2024 reported parent net loss was RMB50.610 million.
Fair value loss of RMB59.643 million is treated as partly non-recurring, but not enough to establish strong cash profit.
Credit impairment of RMB64.176 million and asset impairment of RMB34.802 million are treated as evidence of receivable, inventory and goodwill pressure.
Cash flow statement and capex were not available; large receivables and fixed assets require a heavy cash-profit haircut.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: No operating cash flow table in available annual results announcement; receivables of RMB1.193 billion, inventories of RMB422.598 million and fixed assets/CIP of RMB886.159 million indicate cash conversion risk.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent year loss, no available cash flow statement, long receivable recovery cycle and high operating asset reinvestment needs.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Low confidence and conservatively discounted; cash conversion cannot be verified from the available source.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Not disclosed; manufacturing asset base and CIP imply continuing maintenance/growth capex needs.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables are roughly 109% of 2024 revenue and impairment increased, so distributable cash is much lower than normalized accounting profit.
